pageTitle: Share Your Genshin Impact Version 3.6 Wishes to Win Merchandise and Cash Prizes!
name: Share Your Genshin Impact Version 3.6 Wishes to Win Merchandise and Cash Prizes!
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ In the latest Special Program, we learned a lot about the new upcoming content and gameplay in Version 3.6. Travelers, what are you most looking forward to in Version 3.6? What are some wishes you'd like to fulfill in the new version? Obtaining high scores in "A Parade of Providence" with your wit and battle prowess, exploring the new area and enjoying the desert scenery, or playing through Baizhu's Story Quest to learn more about the owner of Bubu Pharmacy... Come share your wishes and goals for Version 3.6! All Travelers who participate will have a chance to receive Wish Support Rewards that include merchandise, cash prizes, and more! Come take a look~
